items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: His sister, her name was Bella. Piano player, a wonderful piano player.

ctx.x: Yes, I've heard of him. He was down here I think four or five years ago for a while.

He was. He played, he played, he played most all the instruments like his father. He played piano, trumpet, saxophone, beautiful tone in the saxophone. A wonderful musician. His sister, her name was Bella. Piano player, a wonderful piano player.

How was their band the dances? Did they play much really good dance music or was it sort of so much ranged and like, you know, waltzes and all? I mean, they didn't make a hot jazz, you know what I mean?
